COSMORA – Explore Beyond Limits 🚀

We are COSMORA, a team of curious minds passionate about space exploration, science, innovation and discovering the unknown. We believe that every great discovery begins with curiosity and teamwork. Our interests include astronomy, space technology, planetary exploration and creative problem-solving.

We are looking for enthusiastic team members who bring creativity, technical skills, fresh ideas, curiosity and a passion for exploring beyond Earth.
summary: CosmoEarth AI, developed by Team NEBULORA, is an AI-powered Earth and Space Exploration platform that brings information about our planet and the universe together in one user-friendly dashboard. Our project aims to make scientific information easier to access, explore and understand, especially for students, beginners and people interested in science. Instead of searching through multiple websites and platforms for Earth and space-related information, users can explore different topics in one place with the help of interactive features and artificial intelligence.The Space Explorer module focuses on discovering the mysteries of the universe. It allows users to learn about stars, galaxies, comets, meteors and other celestial objects. It is inspired by modern space research, particularly NASA's SPHEREx mission, which demonstrates how infrared observations help scientists investigate the universe. Through this module, users can explore space-related information and understand astronomical concepts in simple language. Our aim is to make astronomy interesting and accessible even to people who do not have advance. Another important feature of our project is Mr. Booth, an interactive AI chatbot represented by a friendly white ghost character. Mr. Booth acts as a virtual guide for users who want to understand Earth and space-related topics. Users can ask questions about satellite images, climate change, deforestation, glaciers, stars, comets, meteors and the SPHEREx mission.
details:
Our project, CosmoEarth AI – Explore Beyond Boundaries, is an AI-powered platform designed to bring Earth and space exploration together in one user-friendly dashboard. The main aim of our project is to help people understand our planet, explore the universe, and learn about environmental and astronomical changes through simple explanations and visual information.

What does the project do and how does it work?

Our project has two major exploration sections: Earth Exploration and Space Exploration.

The Earth Exploration section focuses on forests, climate and weather, glaciers, oceans, and natural disasters. Users can search for locations, explore satellite-image previews, and learn how satellite observations can help identify environmental changes. For example, comparing satellite images from different dates can help us understand changes in forest cover or glacier boundaries.

The Space Exploration section allows users to learn about stars, galaxies, comets, meteors, asteroids, and changes in the night sky. Our project is inspired by NASA's SPHEREx mission, which studies the universe using infrared observations across 102 spectral bands.

Another important feature is Mr. Booth, our friendly AI chatbot represented by a funny white ghost. It is designed to explain complicated Earth and space topics in simple, understandable language. Users can ask questions and learn scientific concepts through easy explanations.

The dashboard also includes Detected Changes, which describes how Earth images and space observations can be compared and verified, and Reports & History, which is planned to maintain observation details and analysis reports.

What are the benefits of the project?

  • Brings Earth and space exploration topics together in one platform.
  • Makes scientific information easier for students and beginners to understand.
  • Helps users learn about environmental changes such as deforestation and glacier melting.
  • Introduces users to astronomical objects and space research.
  • Provides a simple chatbot interface for learning and asking questions.
  • Encourages awareness about our planet and the universe.

What is the intended impact?

Our intended impact is to create awareness about Earth's environmental changes and increase interest in space science. We want to make scientific knowledge more accessible to students, learners, and the general public. In the future, the platform can support environmental education, scientific learning, and better understanding of observations from Earth and space.

What tools, coding languages, hardware, and software were used?

We developed the current dashboard prototype using:

  • HTML: To create the structure and sections of the website.
  • CSS: To design the interface, colours, layouts, animations, and responsive appearance.
  • JavaScript: To add navigation, search, filtering, and interactive chatbot demonstration features.
  • Web browser: To run and test the dashboard.
  • Computer or laptop: Used for development and testing.

The current prototype uses illustrative images and sample educational chatbot responses. Future development can integrate NASA open datasets, verified satellite feeds, official weather and disaster-warning APIs, and a connected AI language model to provide live information and more advanced analysis.

How is the project creative and innovative?

The creative aspect of CosmoEarth AI is that it combines two different areas of exploration—Earth science and space science—in one platform. Instead of making users visit multiple websites to learn about these subjects, our dashboard provides a common place to explore both. We also created Mr. Booth, a friendly ghost-themed chatbot, to make scientific learning more interactive and enjoyable. The change-detection concept adds another innovative feature by showing how observations from different dates can be compared to understand changes.

What factors did our team consider?

Our team considered user-friendliness, accessibility, educational value, accuracy of information, reliability of data sources, and responsive design. We also considered the importance of using verified scientific information rather than presenting unconfirmed observations as facts. We designed the dashboard to be useful for beginners while keeping the possibility of adding advanced scientific features in the future.

Overall, CosmoEarth AI aims to make Earth and space science more accessible, interesting, and understandable. Our vision is to help people explore our planet, discover the universe, and understand the changes happening around us through intelligent technology.
